Hi Alex and Priya,

Great speaking with you earlier — thanks for the time and context on Acme's ingestion and compliance requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: your primary goals are to reduce per-token inference cost on high-throughput ETL pipelines, maintain predictable tail latency for interactive features, and meet audit/logging requirements for GDPR.
- Next step: 45–60m demo + technical deep dive (SE + infra) to walk model performance, routing, and KV/prefix caching options.

Scheduling note: I understand the Acme team spans US and EU; to keep things fair for recurring check-ins we recommend a rotating meeting cadence so the burden of inconvenient times moves across regions. Two rotation options below — please pick the one you prefer and then pick a concrete slot from the links at the bottom.

Rotation option A — weekly rotation (keeps meetings closer to local business hours):
- Week 1: US-friendly (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST)
- Week 2: EU-friendly (08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST)
- Week 3: APAC-friendly (22:00 PT / 01:00 ET +1 / 06:00 BST +1)

Rotation option B — monthly rotation (simpler for planning):
- Month 1: US afternoons / early EU mornings
- Month 2: EU afternoons / US mornings
- Month 3: APAC windows (we schedule early US evenings)

Concrete slot proposals (UTC equivalents included):
- Option 1: 2027-04-08 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST)
- Option 2: 2027-04-08 14:00 UTC (07:00 PT / 10:00 ET / 15:00 BST)
- Option 3: 2027-04-09 00:00 UTC (17:00 PT / 20:00 ET / 01:00 BST +1) — APAC-friendly

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (first-pass mutual action items + owners).

Please reply with: 1) preferred rotation pattern (A or B), and 2) which of the concrete slots works for your team, or book directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m?candidate=acme

If helpful I can also send a Doodle for more than three people.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

Camila Reyes
